description: Ship a polished direct UI showing which scenarios expose measures, at what tier and coverage, with loading/error/empty states, a per-scenario EM rung derived automatically from the decision-trace, and a measures-specific drill-down matching the `measures-health validate` report shape.

requirements.description: Ship a polished direct UI page displaying a fleet-level view of all scenarios, showing which scenarios expose measures, at what tier (full/partial/fallback) and coverage percentage. The UI must include loading, error, and empty states. Each scenario row must display an EM rung derived automatically from the decision-trace. Clicking a scenario row must open a measures-specific drill-down panel matching the `measures-health validate` report shape. The UI must be a translation layer over the Connect RPC API and must not contain business logic.
requirements.title: Fleet-View UI for Measures Coverage Dashboard

validation.notes: Unit test: fleet-view component renders a row per scenario with correct tier badge and coverage percentage when given fixture API response data
Unit test: fleet-view component renders loading spinner when data is being fetched
Unit test: fleet-view component renders error banner when API returns an error
Unit test: fleet-view component renders empty-state illustration when no scenarios are returned
Unit test: drill-down panel renders expected/covered/waived counts and per-measure tier matching the validate report shape
Browser smoke test: load the fleet-view URL; assert the coverage dashboard table renders at least one row with a status badge visible in the DOM
Browser smoke test: click a scenario row; assert the drill-down panel opens and contains at least one measure entry with tier and verdict fields rendered
Browser smoke test: simulate API error by intercepting network; assert error state banner is displayed and no crash occurs
Browser smoke test: simulate empty API response; assert empty-state illustration is displayed
Fleet-view page first contentful paint completes within 3 seconds for a fleet of up to 50 scenarios on the CI browser smoke-test harness

EM rung displayed per scenario in the fleet view matches the rung computed by the EM ladder dimension calculator for the same scenario, verified by cross-checking API response and UI rendered value in the browser smoke test

title: Fleet-View UI
